text.headline: New plans for Claude.
text.body: Free for everyday use. Pro for focused work. Max for high-volume workflows.

caption: Claude by Anthropic has introduced a new pricing structure. A free tier remains for everyday use. Pro, at $17 per month, adds task handoffs, scheduling, and Claude Code. Max, starting at $100 per month, offers higher usage tiers and priority access.
alt_texts: Pricing announcement for Claude by Anthropic.
